patterns.message: The agent SDK may only be imported inside src/main/supervision/agent-runtime/. Everything beyond that boundary consumes the runtime-neutral SessionEvent shape (spec FR-002 to FR-004). Keeping the SDK behind one seam is what lets a runtime upgrade land in one module instead of the state machine, the stall detector, the review queue, and every surface at once (SC-007).

no-restricted-syntax.message: Don't hardcode hex colors in inline `style` — use a theme token, e.g. color: 'var(--text-secondary)'. Hardcoded hex breaks the light theme (see ErrorBoundary regression). Terminal/xterm palettes and workspace color data belong in named constants, not style props.
